day_shape: 74 items: WSJ reports Trump rejected Iran ceasefire proposal expecting post-midterm bombing to resume, US Senate 50-49 kills war-powers resolution, CENTCOM says 122 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, UK FCDO announces new Yemen humanitarian funding, heavy Sacred Defence Week output from Defa Press.

threads.label: US-Iran back-channel talks stall
threads.summary: Reports said Trump rejected Iran's ceasefire proposal and told Xi that Chinese support for Iran was unacceptable, while a US official described mediator talks as positive. Iran's Araghchi said acceptance of Tehran's seven-day plan is now up to Washington, and an Iranian official ruled out nuclear concessions even if the US accepts the Hormuz proposal.

threads.label: US blockade and Senate war-powers vote
threads.summary: CENTCOM said it has redirected 122 commercial vessels under the US blockade of Iran, with 11th MEU Marines training aboard USS Boxer. The Senate voted 50-49 to reject a Democratic resolution requiring congressional authorisation for further action against Iran.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia and UK Yemen aid
threads.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two ballistic missiles and two drones launched by the Houthis toward the kingdom, with Yemen's Presidential Council chair Rashad al-Alimi urging mobilisation against the group. The UK FCDO announced additional humanitarian funding for Yemenis displaced by Houthi escalation.

threads.label: IDF Gaza and Lebanon operations
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed two Hamas operatives including October 7 infiltrator Hassan Mahmoud Siam, destroyed a 2km tunnel in the Yellow Line area of southern Gaza, and reported killing 16 Hamas financial officers who moved over $1 billion. Troops also fired an interceptor at a suspicious aerial target over southern Lebanon.

threads.label: October 7 warning revelations
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported that Egyptian intelligence chief Abbas Kamel visited Israel 11 days before October 7 to warn of a major Hamas attack, and that Netanyahu did not disclose an alleged UAE warning at an October 1, 2023 Gaza security meeting. Related opinion pieces revisited pre-war deterrence doctrine.

threads.label: Sacred Defence Week messaging from Tehran
threads.summary: Defa Press ran extensive Sacred Defence Week content including Navy deputy commander Admiral Bamani claiming the USS Abraham Lincoln "shamefully withdrew" from Hormuz, General Abdollahi's Soldier's Day remarks, and features on war-era figures. IRIB said Pezeshkian's UN speech drew 400 million views on Iranian platforms, and Deputy FM Araghchi described Iran as diplomatically active from Bishkek to New York.

threads.label: Iranian domestic pressures and cultural policing
threads.summary: Tehran prosecutors opened a criminal case against a theatre production over a stage scene between male and female actors, and Iran International reported schoolgirls being forced into hijab while their bareheaded mothers escorted them. IRIB reported the Tehran stock index fell 104,000 units and Fars News criticised the vice-president for attending a Saudi National Day cake-cutting.

events.summary_en: Uncertainty over Iran's 100 billion dollar compensation from Iraq. Reconstruction fund under resolution 598 never formed. International authorities have thus far refrained from activating the implementation mechanisms of clause 7 of resolution 598 and have prevented Iran from receiving 100 billion dollars in compensation from Iraq. events.title_en: Saipa apologises to people regarding arrears. Saipa's chief executive officer, apologising to customers, announced the company's plan to reduce vehicle arrears. It was supposed that arrears on Sohnd, Atlas and Shaheen vehicles would reach zero by the end of Shahrivar, but this target was not achieved for some products. events.summary_en: Spiritual and moral points from Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Revolution. Thought of death. One of the things that destroys and eliminates attachment to the world is thought of death; that is, a person can imagine for a moment that if I think I will be here for another forty years, where am I now? What is my condition? A person sees what things he can attach his heart to; for example, to a certain matter; well, that too comes to an end and goes. What remains? That is what he should attach his heart to. And sometimes a person cannot let go of his attachment, but understands this is false. The Servitude collection contains spiritual and moral points drawn from the lessons of Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei

events.title: Bareheaded mother, veiled daughter: Iran's schools keep a rule its streets have dropped
events.summary: Mothers without headscarves walked daughters in regulation hoods to school in Iran this week. Women who remember 1980 describe the same scene from the year the state began imposing hijab. The picture is identical. What has changed is the society around it.

events.title: Request for Information; Domestic and Near Shore Manufacturing of Essential Medicines on the ASPR 86 List
events.summary: The Office of Management and Budget (OMB) is conducting market research to identify new and unused (idle) domestic, U.S.-based, and near shore production capabilities for Finished Dose Forms (FDF), Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), and Key Starting Materials (KSM) associated with the Administration for Strategic Preparedness and Response (ASPR) 86 list of essential medicines. Responses will be shared with federal agencies that have requirements for essential medicines or responsibilities for strengthening the domestic industrial base for essential generic pharmaceuticals.
